mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT20552.retrieveEmployeeInfo */ em.employee_number AS employee_no , em.full_name_english AS employee_name , em.grade AS grade_code , em.attribute10 AS shift_type_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE', em.grade_title, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM DUAL) as grade_title_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.grade_type AS emp_category_name , em.job_family||'.'||em.job_group||'.'||em.job_detail AS work_type_name , TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as date_hire_subsidiary , TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as date_retire FROM emp_master em WHERE em.employee_number = #{employeeNo}

SELECT SUM(length) length FROM ( SELECT /* LGVATT20552.checkLockDate */ count(1) length FROM TB_ATT_CLOSE_N r WHERE r.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND (time_and_attendance_yyyymm = to_char(TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM') OR time_and_attendance_yyyymm = to_char(TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM')) AND r.confirm_flag = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT count(1) length FROM TB_ATT_LT_TIME_ATTEND_PLAN_N pn WHERE pn.progress_status_code in ('20','30') AND pn.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND (TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') between pn.plan_start_date and pn.plan_end_date OR TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') between pn.plan_start_date and pn.plan_end_date ) UNION ALL SELECT count(1) length FROM TB_ATT_UPDATE_REQ_N rn WHERE rn.progress_status_code in ('20','30') AND rn.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND (rn.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') OR rn.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) UNION ALL SELECT count(1) length FROM TB_ATT_SWAP_HOLIDAY_REQUEST_N sn WHERE sn.progress_status_code in ('20','30') AND sn.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND (sn.weekly_holiday = TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') OR sn.working_day = TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) )

{call /* LGVATT20552.applyAttSwapWhMaster */ lgvatt_transaction_pkg.apply_att_swap_wh_master(#{retCode , mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*po_return_code*/, #{errorMessage, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*po_return_msg*/, #{applicationUserId}, #{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{weeklyHoliday}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{workingDay}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{employeeNo}, #{swapType} ) }
